title: Bounded Perturbation Restart on 14-Layer HfO2/SiO2 Stack
scientific_hypothesis: Widening thickness bounds by ±20% while anchoring central core layers and initializing outer layers with random offsets (N(0, 8 nm)) will escape local optima that caused score regression, allowing gradient optimization to find improved dual-band performance without changing layer count.
design_principle: Bounded perturbation restart preserves verified stack topology while expanding search space around current best configuration; reduced learning rate enables gradual boundary engagement without immediate clipping.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
design_variables: Outer layer initialization with N(0, 8 nm) offsets
manufacturing_considerations: HfO2/SiO2 compatible with plasma ion-assisted deposition
theory_basis: Evolutionary optimization with bounded variables for multilayer structures
Gradient-based thickness optimization with perturbation restart
expected_advantages: Escapes local optima causing score regression
Reduced learning rate prevents boundary clipping
known_risks: May still converge to similar local optimum if landscape is rugged
Wider bounds increase search space and computational cost
Central layer anchoring may restrict exploration
execution_request_english: Optimize a 14-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate for dual-band filtering. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (14 finite layers total). Initialize thicknesses using the best configuration from prior iteration (candidate bragg_stack_opt__gradient_thickness__01) for central layers 5-10, and apply random offsets drawn from N(0, 8 nm) to outer layers 1-4 and 11-14. Set thickness bounds to ±20% relative tolerance around quarter-wave values at 550 nm reference. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with learning rate halved from default (step size reduced by 50%). Run 3 consecutive optimization cycles. Evaluate performance across 1530-1565 nm (maximize transmittance) and 400-700 nm (maximize reflectance) bands at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Incident medium is air. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive for bounded perturbation restart to address score regression from 0.8460 to 0.7833; widens thickness bounds by ±20%, anchors central core layers, initializes outer layers with N(0, 8 nm) offsets, reduces learning rate by 50%
